interpretation: Fresh native devices with the same CPU frustum set. Both controls add one equal-size queue write per camera list; only ascending versus fixed-seed shuffled instance order changes within each experiment. Actual GPU storage indices must match the intervention, and their sorted set must be identical. Reflection lists, source matrices/materials, camera and physical state are unchanged. flatPayload selects a diagnostic-only color/seed vertex payload candidate; continuousShadow selects smooth world-space PCF rotation instead of a discontinuous half-metre hash. lightingProbe observes shadow/roughness/normal variance/sun cosine in the normal attachment while preserving production color arithmetic; subsequent effects use these probe values instead of normals, and captured images are not render quality evidence. Shader instrumentation may change compiler scheduling. Candidate module hashes are recorded. Every captured stage channel is compared exactly against ascending references; shadowInputs additionally reads the initial static map, per-frame dynamic shadow, Frame uniform and light source/cell buffers. Same-order repeat SHA256 is checked independently. Additional dispatches/readbacks/waits are correctness observations, not performance measurements. Divergence and same-order repeatability must be considered together: variation alone does not establish deterministic dependence on instance order or identify a shader/driver cause.
